name: journeypro-complete
description: Complete travel intelligence platform with React frontend, Flask backend, and mobile applications

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd frontend && pnpm run dev --host" "cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python src/main.py"
scripts.start: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python src/main.py
scripts.install-all: cd frontend && pnpm install && cd ../backend && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt

author: JourneyPro Team
